title: Pure Crystron
summary: Crystron Quick-Synchro build incorporating the 2025 support wave (Crystron Sulfador, Tristaros, Inclusion, Cluster, and Eleskeletus) and Crystron Halqifibrax Prism. Non-Tuner Crystrons destroy your own face-up cards to summon Tuners from the Deck, and the Tuners Synchro Summon Machine bosses during the opponent's Main or Battle Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: Crystron Inclusion searches any Crystron card on activation and banishes from the GY to revive a Crystron monster.
Crystron Sulfador destroys 1 Crystron card you control to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY and mills 2 Crystron cards with different names from the Deck (such as Smiger and Thystvern).

Crystron Sulfefnir discards a Crystron to summon itself and destroys itself to summon a Crystron from the Deck, while Smiger, Thystvern, Rosenix, and Prasiortle pop a face-up card to summon a Tuner and banish from the GY to search, make a Token, or summon from hand.

summary.title: Opening: Crystron Inclusion / Crystron Sulfador
steps: Activate Crystron Inclusion to search Crystron Sulfador, then use Sulfador to destroy Inclusion and Special Summon itself, milling Crystron Smiger and Crystron Thystvern.
Banish Thystvern from the GY to search Crystron Tristaros (or Sulfefnir) and banish Smiger to search Crystron Cluster.

Banish Inclusion from the GY to revive a Crystron, summon a Tuner via a non-Tuner's pop effect or climb into Crystron Halqifibrax Prism to cheat out Crystron Quandax, and Set Crystron Cluster for the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Opponent's Turn Quick-Synchros
points: Crystron Tristaros responds to an opponent's effect activation by Special Summoning a Crystron from the Deck and immediately Synchro Summoning a Machine Synchro (such as Crystron Eleskeletus or F.A. Dawn Dragster).
Crystron Citree (revives from GY), Crystron Quan (summons from hand), and Crystron Rion (recovers from banishment) each pair with a non-Tuner on the opponent's turn to Synchro Summon a Machine.

Crystron Halqifibrax Prism summons a Synchro Tuner from the Extra Deck (Crystron Quandax, Shooting Riser Dragon, or Zalen the Shackled Dragon) and banishes itself on the opponent's turn for 3 Tokens, enabling multi-material Synchros like Crystron Quariongandrax (banishes up to 3 monsters) or Crystron Phoenix (banishes all opposing Spells/Traps on field and GY).

summary.title: Bosses, Spells & Restrictions
points: Crystron Eleskeletus (Level 7) recovers a Crystron card from the GY or banishment, weakens opposing monsters by 500 ATK/DEF, and floats when destroyed; two Level 5s (Sulfador, Sulfefnir, or Crystron Ametrix) can also make Cyber Dragon Infinity via an automatic Rank 5.

Crystron Cluster prevents your Crystron cards from being banished by opponent's effects and shuffles a Crystron from the GY or banishment into the Deck to destroy 1 card on the field (or 2 if you control a Crystron Synchro).
Most Crystron main-deck effects lock you into Special Summoning only Machine Synchro Monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Crystron Halqifibrax is Forbidden in the TCG (replaced here by Crystron Halqifibrax Prism), and the page's external Cyber Dragon and Therion packages are omitted from the Main Deck.
